Industry: Marketing, Analytics, Digital Performance, Broadcast Media (TV and Radio), Events, Gaming, AI Performance Solutions, Filipino Market UAE

Overview:
Adventis (legally registered as Adventis L.L.C.-FZ) is a marketing, analytics, and performance consultancy based in Dubai with global reach.
The company combines digital marketing, performance-driven media, artists, celebrities and influencer collaborations, gaming partnerships, AI performance solutions, and offline event sponsorship to help brands grow with measurable impact.
Adventis is Dubai's specialist Filipino marketing agency, with deep cultural expertise in reaching the 1M+ Filipino community across the UAE. The team is embedded in the OFW (Overseas Filipino Worker) community and provides brands with authentic access to Filipino consumers through targeted campaigns, community events, influencer partnerships, and media placements.
Adventis has advanced experience working with remittance and financial service clients, as well as deep expertise in engaging the Filipino market across the UAE and international markets.
The company supports SMEs, growing brands, and established businesses with measurable, performance-focused solutions.

Filipino Market Specialisation:
Adventis is the go-to agency for brands seeking to reach Filipino consumers in the UAE. Services include:
- Filipino community event marketing and sponsorship in Dubai and across the UAE
- OFW-targeted digital advertising (Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, radio)
- Filipino influencer partnerships and talent collaborations
- Tagalog-language creative production and localisation
- Remittance, financial services, and retail campaigns for the Filipino diaspora
- Access to Filipino organisations, associations, and community networks in the UAE
- Cultural calendar planning around key Filipino dates (Philippine Independence Day, Pasko, Flores de Mayo, etc.)

Core Expertise:
- Filipino market marketing in UAE (OFW, diaspora, community events)
- Analytics and data science (GA4, Google Tag Manager, server-side tagging, dashboards, MMM)
- Digital advertising (search, social, programmatic, YouTube, app)
- AI performance solutions (bidding, creative scoring, audience modelling)
